description: Test suite for transcript-tools module, testing functions to extract tool call names, check for tool calls, and count tool results within message content.

methods.name: extractToolCallNames
methods.description: Extracts tool call names from message objects, normalizes, trims, and de-dupes names.

methods.name: hasToolCall
methods.description: Checks whether a message object contains any tool call.

methods.name: countToolResults
methods.description: Counts tool result and error blocks within message content, tracking total and error counts.
